Title: Create a new order with text measurement parameters and verify they are stored and returned correctly
Preconditions: A shop and an item with text measurement parameters are already created in the system
Expected Result: 1. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"status": "success", "message": "Order created successfully", "data": {"orderId": "<non-null string>", "customerName": "John Doe"}}. 2. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the measurement parameter with textValue: {"nameEn": "Special Notes", "nameBn": "বিশেষ নোট", "type": "TEXT", "textValue": "Extra stitching on collar"}.

Title: Update an existing order with new text measurement parameters and verify they are updated correctly
Preconditions: An existing order with at least one item and measurement group is already created in the system
Expected Result: 1. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"status": "success", "message": "Order updated successfully", "data": {"orderId": "<string orderId>"}}. 2. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the updated measurement parameter with textValue: {"nameEn": "Special Notes", "nameBn": "বিশেষ নোট", "type": "TEXT", "textValue": "Extra stitching on sleeves"}.

Title: Verify that error messages in API responses include detailed error information
Preconditions: A shop and an item are already created in the system
Expected Result: HTTP 400 or 500 error response with a JSON body containing: {"status": "error", "message": "An unexpected error occurred:Item not found with ID: 99999"}.

Title: Create a new order with measurement cloth photo and verify it is stored and returned correctly
Preconditions: A shop and an item are already created in the system
Expected Result: 1. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"status": "success", "message": "Order created successfully", "data": {"orderId": "<non-null string>", "customerName": "John Doe"}}. 2. HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing a non-null and valid URL in the field 'measurementClothPhoto'.
